title: Nitpicker analyzer report
description: Language-neutral output contract of a Nitpicker analyzer: an object with a findings array. Extracted from core/diff/comparison/finding-schema.mjs (parseAnalyzerReport / parseFinding). The reference implementation additionally normalizes path separators before applying the path rules below.

path.description: Git-style relative path that stays within the analyzed project: not absolute, no drive letter, no leading '..'.

identity.description: Stable identity used to match a finding between base and head snapshots.

classification.description: enforceable findings fail the gate when new; descriptive findings are report-only; tool-error findings mark an analyzer failure.

toolNotRun.description: Marks a descriptive notice that this snapshot has no report from `tool`. When the base carries one, the comparison reports the head's enforceable findings of that tool as descriptive, since nothing tells which of them the change added.

notRunScope.description: Narrows a toolNotRun notice to the findings of `tool` whose `path` lies in one of these project-relative directories (`.` is the whole project), such as one module's source roots. Without it the notice covers the whole project. On the base, the notice also covers the head path of each file renamed out of these directories; the directories themselves never follow a move. On the head, a notice counts as broken by the change unless a base notice of the same tool has the same comparison key or the base notices of the tool together cover each of its directories.

ratchet.description: Lets an enforceable finding whose identity changed stay baselined: a new finding matching a base finding's ratchet key (with renames applied) is held while its value does not exceed the base value.

worseMessage.description: Message to report instead of `message` when the finding is new only because its value grew past the base value; `{base}` is replaced with the base value.

growthAdvice.description: Text appended to `message` when the finding is new while the base already had findings under the same ratchet key; `{base}` is replaced with the base value.

heldMessage.description: Message to report instead of `message` when the finding is held because its value did not exceed the base value; `{base}` is replaced with the base value.

existingCodeOnly.description: When true, a finding on a line the change added is never held by the ratchet or matched to the base by identity: the code it points at is new.

pathIsFolder.description: When true, `path` is a folder: a base finding with no match at its own path is held at the folder most of its files were renamed to.

divisible.description: When true, the base value is shared: several head findings with the same key are held while their values add up to no more than one unmatched base finding's value (a legacy clone split in two).

mustKeepUnchangedLines.description: Line ranges of head files (project-relative paths) the finding spans. It is held only when every range keeps at least one line the change did not add or edit: a finding made only of changed lines in one of them is code the change wrote, so it is new.

metric.description: Numeric measurement; only descriptive findings may carry one.
